title: Specialist custom-agent roster and enforcement model
statement: Specialist custom-agent roster and enforcement model
body: Proposed for approval: adopt the twelve-agent roster in [AGENT-ROSTER](../agents/AGENT-ROSTER.md): - Three classes: planners (read-only), authors (edit only their own folders, no commands), executors (anchored single-command allow-list plus a narrow edit scope). - Only the orchestrator delegates, one level deep. It cannot be selected by other agents. Specialists return to it. - `agent-policy.json` is the source of truth. Each agent file must match it. `validate-agents.mjs` and `agent-guard.cjs` carry the checks the platform does not. Both are covered by unit and mutation tests. - Product-code write scopes stay closed until a human raises the phase. - Features judged unsupported or not portable are rejected by the validator (handoffs, MCP servers, model pinning, and others).
subject: adr.0006
